title: Barebone Respawn Anchors
description: Makes anchors even more barebone-y, but keeps the vanilla look of Minecraft!
body:
This texture pack changes respawn anchors so that they are simpler. It doesn't have anything else! This pack is an overlay. JOIN MY DISCORD: https://discord.gg/VYY4b5pzUN
